'''Crystal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who oversaw the dancer girls owned by [[Toobu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she was approached by a [[Empire's Wrath|Sith]] and [[Vette]], who was looking for her sister [[Tivva]], and Crystal helpfully directed her to them. Afterwards, the Sith bought the freedom for Tivva and, after thanking Vette, she went her own way, promising to stay in touch.
